description: What a player does in Borderlands 2 that counts as using a Skyrim skill. XP per event = Skyrim's own AVSK use multiplier x base_xp + AVSK use offset (read from the player's Skyrim.esm).

columns.hook: ref hooks.id that sees the event
columns.damage_types: WillowDmgSource_* class names that count ('-' when not damage based)
columns.base_xp: Skyrim 'use' units per event (balance; tune in game)
columns.balanced_in_game: yes once the pace has been played and felt right

rows.filter: player hits an enemy with a pistol, SMG or melee
player hits an enemy with a shotgun or rocket launcher
player hits an enemy with a sniper or assault rifle
player takes a hit while the shield is up
player picks up a gun or item; scaled by rarity level
player takes a hit to health (shield down)
each second moving at speed with a hostile within 30 m
money goes up outside a vendor trade (cash pickups)
player opens a chest, locker, safe or box
player's burn/corrode/shock/slag ticks hurt an enemy
player buys or sells at a vending machine
shield refills to full after being hit
player hits an enemy with an elemental gun (direct hit)
player falls into Fight For Your Life, and again on each Second Wind
player is healed (not shield restores, not the mod's own regen)
player picks up an elemental gun
